## 提交确认 / Submission checklist

- [ ] 修改聚焦于一个明确问题，没有混入无关重写。
- [ ] 理论、实践观察、实践解释、对象事实和当前推断保持区分。
- [ ] 新增或修改的来源包含可追溯位置、方法、适用条件和限制。
- [ ] 行为变化已经补充或更新相关评测案例。
- [ ] 没有提交私人档案、购买记录、完整冲煮数据库或未经授权的受版权保护资料。
- [ ] 我已阅读 `CONTRIBUTING.md`，确认有权提交这些内容，并同意其中的贡献授权条款。

---

- [ ] The change is focused on one defined problem and contains no unrelated rewrite.
- [ ] Established knowledge, practice observation, practice explanation, object fact, and current inference remain distinct.
- [ ] New or revised sources include traceable locations, methods, conditions, and limitations.
- [ ] Relevant evaluation cases were added or updated for behavioral changes.
- [ ] No private profiles, purchase history, complete brew databases, or unauthorized copyrighted material are included.
- [ ] I have read `CONTRIBUTING.md`, have the right to submit this material, and agree to its contribution terms.
